title: First production Live Intelligence -> Analysis relationship
decision: Open one bounded production Live-to-Analysis relationship using the completed July 2026 Japan Family Income and Expenditure Survey occurrence.
contract_requirements: The first production bridge row must select one immutable Live observation_id.
The selected Live observation must link to the same canonical occurrence as the Analysis review when used as FACTUAL_INPUT.
Live evidence and Analysis evidence remain separate registries; no transitive evidence migration.
The July FIES observation is ECONOMIC_DATA_OBSERVATION, not DATA_REVISION; retrospective Apr-Jun revisions are preserved as contemporaneous context without inventing prior Live history.

Reuters-reported consensus may establish a defensible surprise benchmark, but benchmark-vintage comparability must be caveated because the Statistics Bureau applied a pre-announced CPI 2025-base retrospective revision on 4 September.
Canonical timing remains day precision Asia/Tokyo with null UTC; Live/Analysis evidence may not backfill a release clock time.
Public Live observation projection and public Live-input projection remain closed.
Automatic ingestion, story clustering, Canonical commit and Calendar writes remain false.
Further production Live-input growth requires another pressure audit.
